Asset type: one finished 16:9 cinematic animation keyframe for a YouTube film about a programmer and AI, allegory "The path that draws itself".
Scene: a dense quiet forest of tall, irregular charcoal trees, dark graphite trunks and hand-hatched bare branches receding into a pale mist. The ground is flat paper-grey with faint hand-drawn texture. Restrained palette: warm grey paper, charcoal black forest, ivory character, one warm amber-yellow line.
Hero: one extremely simple, unmistakable STICK FIGURE, drawn as thin clean ivory chalk strokes. A single hollow circular head, one straight torso stroke, two single-stroke arms and two single-stroke legs. No filled torso, no clothing, no facial features, no fingers, no human anatomy. The head is about one quarter of the figure's height. The character is at lower-left-centre, about 18 percent of the frame's height, facing right, bent forward in a simple kneeling drawing pose. Its right arm holds a little amber pencil against the ground.
Action captured: the pencil tip touches a single thin amber-yellow path line at ground level. A short line runs in from the left edge toward the character and stops just ahead of the pencil, with an unmarked forest floor to the right. The character is actively drawing the next small piece of path.
Style: sophisticated spare hand-drawn 2D animation still, charcoal and chalk on subtly textured paper, a personal illustrated essay, atmospheric and slightly melancholy, appealing clean silhouette, coherent intentional composition. Absolutely not photorealistic, not 3D, not a game screenshot.
Framing: continuous side-on stage view, wide landscape 16:9, fixed camera at character height; forest gives depth through layered flat drawings but the stick figure and path read as simple 2D. Clear negative space around the character. Keep the line modest and warm rather than a neon light effect.
Constraints: only one character and one small pencil, no text, no lettering, no title, no watermark, no panel borders, no storyboard grid, no robots, no houses, no extra colors, no large glowing portal. One complete image, not a collage. The scene must allow this exact figure and forest design to carry through subsequent animation shots.
